title: Workshop 5: Categorizing Money Conversations
instruction: Not all financial topics should be approached the same way. Classifying topics can help facilitators choose the best way to present them. Drag and drop or click/tap to select each of the topics below and sort them into their category columns.

tips.simple: Filler Tip: To make simple topics engaging, use quick-fire quizzes, interactive matching games, and real-life scenario simulations to keep learners active.
tips.dry: Filler Tip: Dry topics (like terms of service or regulation details) can be made engaging by using storytelling, gamification elements, or group problem-solving exercises.
tips.complex: Filler Tip: For complex topics, break them into clear modular micro-lessons, use visual flowcharts, step-by-step progress trackers, and detailed case studies.
tips.hot: Filler Tip: Engage learners on hot-button topics by facilitating anonymous voting, structuring debates, using roleplay, and offering space for reflection.
